known.title: Leave production-check results blank until the owner walk-through

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a reader treats the CWF-3 production check as passed before the reserved owner walk-through. The section says the coordinator will record results later and to leave result cells blank, but every check is marked Pass. The recorded ruling explicitly calls for a checklist without live results.
findings.title: Leave production-check results blank until the owner walk-through
